Hi Laura — update after our investigation.

Summary of findings (short):
- Root cause: A backfill job executed on Oct 1 at 02:14 UTC with request IDs prefixed "backfill-" was incorrectly routed through one of your production API keys because a staging-to-prod key mapping in your CI pipeline was rotated the night before. The backfill ran for ~3.2 hours and generated a large number of short-lived sessions; our telemetry shows ~81% of tokens billed on Oct 1 linked to that job.
- Attribution: We produced a per-prefix attribution table (sample rows below) and matched all "backfill-" requests to the Oct 1 burst.
  - backfill-*: 18,920,311 tokens (78.9%)
  - stg-*: 2,012,433 tokens (8.4%)
  - prod-*: 2,930,122 tokens (12.7%)
- VAT/legal-entity mapping: The sessions from the misrouted key were attributed to Pelago GmbH in our billing system due to the key being registered under that entity. You asked to bill Pelago Ltd; we can reassign the affected sessions.

Next steps we've taken:
- We have provisionally issued a one-time invoice credit equal to the billed amount for the "backfill-" sessions (credit memo 2026-10-CM-71). This appears on your portal as a pending credit and reduces the outstanding balance.
- We will reissue a corrected invoice (2026-10A) with the "backfill-" sessions reallocated to Pelago Ltd, and with VAT recomputed for each entity. You should see the corrected PDF by COB Oct 21.
- Engineering: we added a transient rule to block requests containing "backfill-" from being routed to production keys; we recommend rotating keys and verifying CI mapping rules before re-running backfills.

Attachments in our follow-up (available in portal): per-prefix-attribution-sample.csv, credit-memo-2026-10-CM-71.pdf (we will upload full logs to the secure share if you need them for audit).

Ben and Markus — please confirm finance is comfortable with the credit memo and reissue process. Markus, if you want us to route the corrected invoice through your AR system (net-30 vs immediate), confirm terms and we'll adjust.

Laura — apologies for the disruption. We'll keep this case open until you confirm the corrected invoice and that the VAT split matches your accounting.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
